text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — draft timeline for the Q4 performance cycle ready. Please skim and flag conflicts.

elaine: High-level dates: self-reviews open 2025-11-03, self-reviews close 2025-11-10, manager reviews due 2025-11-17, calibration week 2025-11-24 to 2025-11-28, final ratings locked 2025-12-01.

raj: Thanks — does calibration week include a hard freeze on score changes?

elaine: Yes. During calibration week managers can propose changes but nothing is final until the calibration meeting notes are recorded and people-ops flips the "locked" flag.

mike: Heads-up: product has an offsite 11/25. Can we avoid major calibration meetings that day?

elaine: Good call. We will avoid scheduling cross-org calibration on 11/25. We can do small team calibrations that day if needed.

jess: Can people-ops share the manager guidance doc and the updated review form (with behavioral anchors)? I want managers to have examples for each band.

elaine: Yep — here's the link to the guidance and form: https://confluence.redwood.ai/perf-cycle/q4-2025 (form is labelled "Q4-2025 Manager Review Form"). Please use the latest template — it has numeric anchors and example phrasing.

elaine: Quick checklist for managers:
• remind direct reports to submit self-reviews by 11/10
• complete manager reviews by 11/17
• add calibration notes in the shared sheet before your slot
• attend your calibration slot during 11/24–11/28 or assign a delegate

raj: What's the deadline for appeals or rating change requests after calibration?

elaine: Appeals window is 5 business days after final ratings locked (so through 2025-12-08). Appeals go to people-ops + your manager's mgr. We expect only edge cases.

people-ops-bot: Reminder queued — self-reviews open in 48 hours. Link to self-review: https://hr.redwood.ai/self-review

mike: Are calibration slots assigned or sign-up?

elaine: We'll publish a sign-up calendar Monday and pre-assign managers who had recent hires or cross-team dependencies. If you need a different slot DM me.

jess: One more — can we get a short 30m training for new managers on scoring and bias mitigation the week before manager reviews are due?

elaine: Yes. I'll set a session for 11/12 with a recording and slides. RSVP will be in the calendar invite.

raj: Thanks — this looks doable. I'll push reminders to my managers and follow up after the training. :thumbsup:

elaine: Awesome. If you spot conflicts please post them here or DM me. Thanks all!
